verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a first-party batch-job capability: large SQL operations run as batches of retryable tasks, with live progress and controls to pause, retry, or cancel (docs-15). It adds cross-table partition operations that re-point parts without copying rows (docs-33) and cluster-wide querying (docs-20). Agents can run SQL against the database over MCP (docs-7). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the batch-job controls are exposed to agents via MCP or an API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk-operation behavior at scale.
